sources.title: What is Ollama - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: By bringing AI models directly to users' devices, Ollama ensures greater control and security over data while providing faster processing speeds and reduced reliance on external servers. Extensive Model Library: Ollama offers access to an extensive library of pre-trained LLMs, including popular models like Llama 3.

sources.title: Run Your Own AI Model Locally: A Practical Ollama Setup Guide (2026)
sources.snippet: Running AI models locally has become surprisingly accessible. With Ollama, you can run capable language models on a laptop or desktop — no API keys, no subscriptions, no internet required. Here's a practical guide to getting set up, choosing the right model, and actually using local AI for something useful.
